scripts.deploy: npm run build:web && (wrangler deploy || (sleep 10 && wrangler deploy)) && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.build:web: if command -v cargo >/dev/null && [ -f ../rust/web/build.sh ]; then bash ../rust/web/build.sh; else echo 'Skipping the web app: needs the Rust repo and toolchain (rust/web/build.sh)'; fi

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret of the Google OAuth client named in GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID (Google Cloud Console → Google Auth Platform → Clients).

ALLOWED_DOMAINS.description: Comma-separated Google Workspace domains allowed to sign in.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Google OAuth client of type TVs and Limited Input devices.
